I implemented the custom attribute-based dimension-naming mechanism to replace PyTorch's native named-tensor API.

### Core changes — `dims_spec/tensor_naming.py`
- **`get_dim_names(tensor)`** (new): reads the `_dim_names` attribute via `getattr(tensor, "_dim_names", None)`, falling back to `(None,) * tensor.ndim`.
